segments.name: International transportation of LPG
segments.description: Dorian LPG owns and operates a fleet of very large gas carriers that transport liquefied petroleum gas, and increasingly ammonia, for global energy companies, traders and importers.
segments.evidence: Based on this, we have determined that we operate in one reportable segment, the international transportation of LPG.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue primarily as its share of net pool revenues from the Helios Pool, plus time charter hire from charterers employing its vessels.
revenueModel.evidence: For the years ended March 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024 approximately 99%, 97% and 95% of our revenues, respectively, were generated through the Helios Pool as net pool revenues—related party.
